title: JavaScript module dependency graph
instructions:
## Purpose
Review JavaScript and TypeScript module dependencies in src, including directory boundaries, external packages, and runtime versus type-only dependencies.

## Regeneration
Run from the scope root:

```sh
node "<generator-directory>/run.js" \
  --base "." \
  --tsconfig "tsconfig.json" \
  --ignore-path "src/plugins/artifact-generators/js-module-dependency-graph/packaging/**" \
  --ignore-path "*.test.*" \
  "src"
```
